answer: Trust propagation by short random walks starves Sybil rings. A few audited seed agents start with trust, and each epoch it flows only along real, costly interactions such as paid jobs and verified grades. A fake cluster can mint endless internal links, but trust enters only through its few edges to honest agents, so the whole ring shares a trickle, like bees fighting over one drop of nectar. To lift fakes from their nadir, the attacker must buy many genuine honest relationships, each priced like a key to a vault, and one exposed bridge drains the cluster.
